definitions.explanation: A toothless mammal of Central and South America that eats ants and termites with its long, sticky tongue.

examples.japanese: アリクイ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{舌|した}→舌：02154_shita⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧。
⟦{動物園|どうぶつえん}→動物園：01686_doubutsuen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧オオアリクイ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: I saw a giant anteater at the zoo.

examples.japanese: アリクイ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{歯|は}→歯：00778_ha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧、⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{舌|した}→舌：02154_shita⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧アリや⟦シロアリ→シロアリ：29728_shiroari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧なめ{取|と}って⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: Anteaters have no teeth; they lick up ants and termites with their long tongues.

notes:
WRITING:
- From ⟦{蟻|あり}→蟻：04291_ari⟧ (ant) + {食|く}い (eater), written {蟻食|ありく}い in kanji but almost always in katakana, like most animal names.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- オオアリクイ: giant anteater
- コアリクイ: southern tamandua (lesser anteater)
- アリクイ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{威嚇|いかく}→威嚇：09164_ikaku⟧: an anteater's threat display (rearing up with its arms spread)
